question: Gurudongmar Lake is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gurudongmar Lake is one of the highest lakes in the world and India, situated at an altitude of 5,154 m (16,900 ft), in the Indian state of Sikkim.
 
• It is considered sacred to the Buddhists, Sikhs, and Hindus.
 
• The lake is named after Guru Padmasambhava (the founder of Tibetan Buddhism).
 
• Cholamu Lake and Tsonmgo Lake are located in Sikkim.
